newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hiap Moh sells warehouse for S$1.88 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hiap Moh sells warehouse for S$1.88 mln.

text.p: Hiap Moh Corporation said on Tuesday it had sold a warehouse for Singapore $1.88 million.
Hiap Moh, which makes and trades paper products, said the sale of the property was in line with its rationalisation of warehousing and stocking policies.
"It would be more cost effective to stock and deliver the bulk of the goods from the company's factory-warehouse in Jurong," a company statement said.
It said the sale proceeds would be used to reduce bank borrowings and for working capital.
